name: add-project-management
description: Install cross-actor project management into any agent — GitHub Issues as the single source of truth, uniform task anatomy with approval-ready completion lattice (open → pending-verification → done), loop closure in both directions (the agent closes its loops with you; you get handed the loops only a human can close with other people or agents, aged and pre-drafted), autonomous project steward with escalation ladder, and projection sync (Google Tasks adapter v1). Works standalone; no dependency on fleet infrastructure.
